description: This PHP source file defines the SaveEmployeeController class within the OrangeHRM system. The class manages the preparation of data and components related to saving employee information, including generating a new employee ID and configuring properties for frontend UI rendering. It utilizes various services and traits to handle authentication, ID generation, and component creation, adhering to the MVC pattern.

classes.name: SaveEmployeeController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing employee save operations, including setting up the frontend component with necessary data like employee ID and image types, and determining password requirements based on social media authentication status.

methods.name: getIdGeneratorService
methods.description: Provides an instance of IDGeneratorService, creating one if it does not already exist.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering by setting up properties such as employee ID, allowed image types, and password requirement status based on social media authentication.
